toolInventory.name: ops.search_tools
toolInventory.handler: Bounded registry search; TRACE invocation wrapper also records an Engram observation.
toolInventory.auth: No operator token required for discovery.

toolInventory.name: ops.inspect_tool_contract
toolInventory.handler: Reads in-memory contract metadata; TRACE invocation wrapper records an Engram observation.
toolInventory.auth: No operator token required for discovery.

toolInventory.name: ops.validate_tool_call
toolInventory.handler: Preflight validation only; TRACE invocation wrapper records an Engram observation.
toolInventory.auth: No operator token required for preflight.

toolInventory.name: ops.propose_patch
toolInventory.handler: Reads source and returns a patch preview; does not apply it. TRACE invocation wrapper persists an observation.

toolInventory.name: ops.record_fix_attempt
toolInventory.handler: Inserts fix-attempt data into PostgreSQL; TRACE invocation wrapper also persists an observation.

toolInventory.name: ops.run_targeted_test
toolInventory.handler: Spawns Vitest for supplied target; tests may have their own side effects. TRACE invocation wrapper persists an observation.

toolInventory.name: ops.fixer_semantic_recall
toolInventory.handler: Queries fixer-memory projections; TRACE invocation wrapper persists an observation.
toolInventory.auth: No write authorization; inspect runtime token wrapper before calling.

toolInventory.name: ops.fixer_pattern_store
toolInventory.handler: Writes PostgreSQL fixer_patterns and fixer_run_log; may update Redis and Qdrant. Formal TRACE contract and implementation both classify it as storage-mutating.

toolInventory.name: graph.expand_neighborhood
toolInventory.handler: Bounded graph neighborhood traversal; TRACE invocation wrapper persists an Engram observation.
toolInventory.auth: Graph-read path; no task mutation authority.

toolInventory.name: trace.kag_search
toolInventory.handler: Retrieval cascade; TRACE invocation wrapper persists an Engram observation and retrieval subcalls may emit resource telemetry.
toolInventory.auth: Read path; result must still pass ACE canonicalization before model context.

toolInventory.name: atlas.keyword_corpus_search
toolInventory.handler: Searches schema-validated .okf keyword corpus; reference-only output, not canonical admission. TRACE invocation wrapper applies when registered through the wrapped server.

toolInventory.name: atlas.materialize_feature_evidence_tuples
toolInventory.handler: Bounded canonical-source read and proposal materialization; TRACE invocation wrapper additionally persists an Engram observation.

toolInventory.name: atlas.graph.pagerank
toolInventory.handler: Authorized graph-projection read; returned ranks do not establish canonical identity. TRACE invocation wrapper persists an observation.

toolInventory.name: atlas.backend_info / atlas.exact_topk_oracle / atlas.parity_report / atlas.simdjson_tensor_metrics
toolInventory.handler: Native acceleration fixtures and backend metadata; registered before TRACE global invocation instrumentation. Fixture parity is not production corpus or GPU proof.

toolInventory.name: atlas.kanban_dag_prefill_recommendation
toolInventory.handler: Bounded snapshot and recommendation only; never claims, dispatches, or changes task state. TRACE invocation telemetry applies.

toolInventory.name: recommend_kanban_dag_prefill_algorithm
toolInventory.handler: Separate atlas-tools MCP server; bounded snapshot proposal, no claim or status mutation.

toolInventory.name: classify_intent / build_recommendation
toolInventory.handler: Intent classification plus bounded live retrieval to ground a recommendation; not an execution command. The latter performs source retrieval.

toolInventory.name: record_outcome
toolInventory.handler: Can persist outcome records to the explicitly guarded loopback PostgreSQL scratch target and other configured outcome projections; not a verified task completion owner unless claim/lease/verification fields are validated.
toolInventory.auth: Scratch URL and schema/runtime gates; write-capable.

toolInventory.name: gpu_vram_status
toolInventory.handler: Reads nvidia-smi and llama-server slots; does not stop services. Live runtime status is not queried by this audit.

toolInventory.name: gpu_request_vram_release
toolInventory.handler: Writes an idempotent request record to a local file; does not stop a process. Production record omits testOnly.
toolInventory.auth: Unauthenticated request-only notice; human runs lifecycle task.

toolInventory.name: GPU compute tools (ops.gpu_topk / ops.gpu_pagerank / ops.gpu_attention)
toolInventory.handler: Compute may use a native export or CPU reference; persisted resource telemetry is written through packet-centric PostgreSQL telemetry. Telemetry does not prove CUDA kernel execution.
toolInventory.auth: Operator-gated contract; no GPU tool invoked.

toolInventory.name: trace.system_health
toolInventory.handler: Source marks rerank optional and topology_search required; deployed behavior still needs operator restart and live read.

findings.fixerPatternStoreClassification: CONFIRMED_DISCREPANCY: generated docs/reports/mcp-tool-registry-index.json says permissions=read_only and writes_to=[], while TRACE formal registry says WRITE and the implementation mutates PostgreSQL, with optional Redis/Qdrant updates. Correct the generated index from the source owner before using it for routing or authorization.
findings.traceInvocationPersistence: Tools registered after the registerTool monkey-patch record observations in Engram (PostgreSQL-backed path); handler-level READ does not mean the overall invocation has no persistence side effect. Native acceleration tools are registered before this wrapper.

operatorToken.finding: The verifier rejects missing/short tokens and an unconfigured secret, then compares SHA-256 digests with timingSafeEqual. This is source inspection only; no secret was read and no live positive-token request was made.

findings.viterbi: No registered/callable Viterbi routing tool was established by this bounded source audit. Keep Viterbi as a challenger.
findings.liveToolList: NOT_RUN; static registration does not prove deployed process availability or loaded-source revision.
findings.workflow: Tool discovery and preflight exist. Evidence materialization, retrieval, recommendation, verification, and mutation are distinct. No complete execution proof is established without a revision-bound durable claim, authorized command, independent receipt, and Kanban readback.

dependencyReferences.status: REVIEW_REQUIRED; no edges inferred or promoted by this audit

openGates: TRACE token configured and positive/negative live comparison verified by operator without exposing the secret.
TRACE operator restart and live system_health response for optional rerank behavior.
Resolve any generated-registry discrepancy against the current tool owner and actual side effects.
Provide task-bound criterion evidence, exact verification command/result receipts, and dependency mappings before computing a total per-task evidence score.
Keep write-capable tools uncalled until a reviewed task, authorization, and execution receipt path are admitted.
